changelog:
Initial release for capturing and sharing OpenRouter Rankings daily digest:

- Captures screenshots for all Categories scenarios and page sections on openrouter.ai/rankings.
- Generates a sales-friendly summary, compiling Top 5 rankings and key highlights.
- Creates a structured Feishu doc with ordered screenshots and summaries; sends doc link and brief digest via Feishu chat.
- Built-in validation ensures only complete and correct screenshots are used; handles failures with clear notifications.
- Designed for daily automated use with preset defaults for directory, doc format, and Feishu integration.
summary: Capture OpenRouter Rankings (all Categories scenarios + page sections), create Feishu doc with screenshots and sales summary. Use for openrouter.ai/rankings...
